decision.reasoning_trace: I selected a consideration set of 5 products that best meet the customer's needs for a mechanical keyboard. I prioritized products with high ratings, good reviews, and a low price point. The G.Skill KM360 tenkeyless mechanical keyboard was chosen as the final product due to its high rating of 4.7, numerous positive reviews, and reasonable price of $55.99. This keyboard meets the needs of a customer looking for a reliable, high-quality mechanical keyboard for gaming and everyday use.
